ARIS-in-AI-Offer (ARIS in 秋招)

 Hoping to make your 秋招 (qiūzhāo, Chinese AI campus recruiting season) a little easier 🌱
 
 📖 中文版 (Chinese version) : README CN.md

 📱 One link for everything: easyaioffer.github.io (short address; the site itself is wanshuiyin.github.io/ARIS-in-AI-Offer) — every sheet on one page, searchable, 中/EN switch, dark mode, and a per-reader 已读 tracker. Save it on your phone.

 📚 Jump to a topic — 35 first-party cheat sheets across 8 categories, plus a community-contributed question bank:

🧠 General / Foundations · 🎯 Post-Training & Reasoning · 🏛️ LLM Architecture & Systems · 🌊 Generative Models — Theory & Tokenizers · 🎨 Generation Systems (Image / Video / 3D / Diffusion Post-Training) · 👁️ Multimodal · 🤖 Agents · 🦾 Embodied AI & World Models / 具身与世界模型

Or browse the full 📚 Tutorial Index ↓ · jump to 🌐 ARIS-Homepage ↓.

 · · · · · 

 🏆 Built on a battle-tested foundation — the ARIS main repo has 10k GitHub stars, was HuggingFace Daily Papers 1, won AI Digital Crew Project of the Day, and ships 74+ research skills across 7+ platforms. This isn't a vaporware preview — every cheat sheet here is the production output of the same /interview-cheatsheet + /render-html workflow used in academic-research production.

A curated, bilingual (中文 + English) collection of ML / LLM / multimodal / diffusion / agent / generative-model interview cheat sheets, auto-generated by the ARIS — Auto Research in Sleep /render-html workflow.

Each cheat sheet is a long-form Chinese tutorial with: formula derivations · from-scratch PyTorch code · 25 high-frequency interview questions (L1 essentials · L2 advanced · L3 top-tier lab).

 
 
 

 📖 Preview (above): one snapshot per pillar, taken from the Diffusion Foundations cheat sheet — ① Foundations (formula derivations + intuition + TL;DR), ② Interview Q&A (25 high-frequency questions stratified L1/L2/L3), ③ From-Scratch Code (runnable PyTorch, including CFG training + DDIM sampling). Every cheat sheet in this collection follows the same three-pillar structure.

 
 🌐 ARIS-Homepage preview — CV → fact-checked academic homepage (click to expand) 

 
 
 

Same /render-html workflow turning a CV into a fact-checked academic homepage. Live demo at wanshuiyin.github.io. Details + pipeline diagram in the ARIS-Homepage section ↓.

 

 
 📝 Long-form blog preview — A Survey on Continuous DLM (2026 H1) (click to expand) 

 
 
 
 
 

A standalone hand-authored long-form technical survey. A Survey on Continuous DLM (2026 H1, 6 papers) — Chinese-language survey by Ruofeng Yang (SJTU), written end-to-end via cross-model discussion (Claude Opus 4.7 + Codex GPT-5.5 xhigh + Gemini auto-gemini-3). 📖 Read full blog ↗ .

 

 📱 HTML reads cleanly everywhere

Phone on the subway, iPad at a café, laptop in the library — same HTML link opens equally well:

- 🧮 MathJax renders all LaTeX formulas ( not screenshots — scalable, copyable, selectable)
- 💻 highlight.js colors all PyTorch code blocks
- 📐 Responsive layout adapts to any window width — no overflow, no blur
- 📑 Sticky TOC for jumping around long documents
- 💾 Single-file HTML — download once, read offline, no backend required

---

 📢 What's New

- 2026-09-11 — 🌍 35 World Models + a 2025–26 refresh of 3D Generation and Quantization — from community feedback ("3D 和 WM 有点少/老", "quant 主流用 PTQ 和 QAT"). World Models is new and deliberately curated — influential, representative, major-lab, open-weight work only, with the selection rule stated in the sheet and the famous-but-excluded listed with reasons: latent dynamics (RSSM → Dreamer v1–4, MuZero, TD-MPC2) · JEPA (I-/V-JEPA, V-JEPA 2/2.1, DINO-WM) · generative/interactive (Genie → Genie 3, GameNGen, Cosmos 1→3, Matrix-Game 3.0, Atlas) · three embodied routes · evaluation and the definition fight. 3D gains feed-forward reconstruction (DUSt3R → VGGT → MapAnything / DA3, with the confidence-loss derivation), feed-forward 3DGS, native mesh generation (MeshGPT → Meshtron, tokenization budgets), TRELLIS.2 / Hunyuan3D 2.x on a latent-representation axis, part-level and sim-ready assets; five duplicated L3 questions replaced. Quantization §10 rewritten around QAT: PACT/LSQ derivations, ParetoQ, Gemma 3/4 official QAT weights, Apple's 2-bpw on-device stack, DeepSeek FP8 / NVFP4 / MXFP8 training recipes — and the 2026 PTQ-vs-QAT guidance with costs cited rather than asserted. All bilingual; new runnable code/world models toy.py (RSSM balanced-KL fixed point, JEPA shortcut, gridworld LAM — asserts against analytic answers). Research fanned out to Opus 5 with every arXiv ID fetched; drafts reviewed by gpt-6-astra xhigh in 2–3 rounds each. world models tutorial.html .
- 2026-09-10 — 🎯 34 Modern Diffusion Post-Training: Flow-GRPO · DGPO · DiffusionNFT — the three 2025 online-RL methods for flow-matching T2I, organised around the one thing that separates them: how the reward enters the gradient — per-step policy gradient on a marginal-preserving SDE, group-level DPO with the $\log Z$ cancellation, or a reflected two-branch regression on the forward process. Flow-GRPO moves here out of the Diffusion Post-Training sheet, with its reverse-SDE sign and closed-form KL corrected on the way. Bilingual , with a runnable script ( code/diffusion online rl.py — analytic checks of marginal preservation, the NFT update sign, and DGPO's balanced weights) and 25 高频题. Design-reviewed before drafting (64 guardrails) plus three review rounds, all gpt-6-astra xhigh. modern diffusion post training tutorial.html .
 
 📋 Earlier updates (22) 

- 2026-07-31 — ✂️ Interview-scannability overhaul for 30-33 + collection-wide table-scroll fix — responding to reader feedback ("comprehensive but unscannable before an interview"): Transformer Block restructured — the concrete block assembly + dataflow + runnable code moved from a buried §7 up to §1 (answer first, rationale after); all four de-hedged — lead sentence states the conclusion, qualifiers demoted to notes, one canonical home

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
There is no aris-homepage executable — this repo ships no installer, so call the script directly. The path is relative to where you are standing, which changes at the cd:

python tools/aris_homepage.py init --from-cv ./cv.pdf --out ./site
cd ./site
# Calling agent fills .aris-homepage/extraction.json per EXTRACTION_HANDOFF.md
python ../tools/aris_homepage.py finalize
$EDITOR profile.yml             # tweak editorial choices
python ../tools/aris_homepage.py render --persona theory-minimal

🪟 On Windows? Use \ in the paths above, and mind the Windows-only traps — the python3 alias stub, silent .py file association, non-ASCII pdftotext paths, SSL certificates. Full walkthrough: WINDOWS_en.md (中文).

Output: index.html + audit-report.md. Drop the HTML on GitHub Pages, S3, university ~user/public_html/, or attach to email — no build server. Minimum runtime is just Python + a calling LLM agent; Codex MCP optional for adversarial cross-model review; Gemini multimodal optional for visual critique.
